title: Care COMPASS Study
official: Care COMPASS Study: (Care Companion for Patient Activation and Self-Support)
summary: This is a prospective, single-arm, mixed-methods pilot study at a single academic medical center to observe the impact, feasibility and acceptability of an AI Care Companion tool on activation and confidence among patients with chronic disease attending outpatient care.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age: Legal adult (18+)
* Existing diagnosis of Diabetes Mellitus Type 1 / 2 and/or hypertension who have had at least two outpatient visits in the prior 12 months.
* Scheduled in-person clinician appointment for follow up of Diabetes Mellitus -----Type 1 / 2 and/or hypertension within the next 4 months
* Anticipate ongoing care with their current clinic for at least one month following their clinic visit for this research study.
* Able to contact their health care team as needed (by telephone, messaging or other) in the 2 weeks following their clinic visit.
* Able to read and write in English
* Has an active patient portal account
* Current user of smart phones.
* Access to wifi or internet

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with emergency or acute medical issues arising at their scheduled appointment
* Pregnancy (based on self-report or medical records),
* Any other medical condition or other reason- as determined by the principal investigator or designee - that may affect participant involvement, study procedures or data collection
* Participants who have already participated in this study.
* Participating currently (or in the last 6 months) with a clinical trial of a health coaching intervention.
